scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible finite diagnostic checks are included. Earlier central laws and deterministic-volume results credited.
scientific_limitations: Only Haar-oriented hyperplanes through an axially displaced point in a Euclidean regular simplex. Finite-dimensional formulas distinguish interior from vertex endpoint; fixed-displacement and critical-window limits are separate. Historical priority not conclusively established; independent external validation not performed.
title: Axial displacement of random simplex sections: exact means and a critical fluctuation crossover
